create_classification_dataset: create a synthetic classification dataset with 9 samples, 2 features, and 3 classes using make_classification
build_nca_embedding: build a NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis model to learn a distance metric that maximizes nearest neighbors accuracy
fit_nca_model: fit a NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis model on labeled data to learn an optimal stochastic embedding
transform_data_with_nca: transform data using a fitted NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis model to project into learned embedding space
compute_softmax_distances: compute numerically stable softmax distances between points using logsumexp trick for NCA optimization
